verdict.rationale: IVS documents broadcasting a real-time stage to a channel using either client-side or server-side composition, and says real-time audiences can go beyond 25,000 viewers with up to 12 hosts. A community report confirms that IVS channels output HLS (m3u8), so viewers can watch at scale without joining the stage. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on stage-to-channel egress setup, documented RTMP egress to third-party destinations, and hands-on corroboration of the stage-to-HLS path.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session

citations.quote: When broadcasting the stage to a channel, you have the option of client-side composition at no extra cost or [server-side composition](#Server-side_Composition) which incurs an additional hourly rate.
Accommodate audiences beyond 25,000 viewers and enable up to 12 hosts to take the virtual stage.
noting it takes RTMP in and outputs m3u8
